course_id: Hệ thống thông tin kế toán 2
title: Information Systems in Accounting 2

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply internal controls in accounting information systems.
Analyze and manage accounting processes such as sales, purchases, payroll, production, and reporting.
Identify and describe data flow in accounting information systems.
Recognize and mitigate risks associated with accounting information systems.
Create and interpret documentation for accounting information systems.
